name: The Gilded Exhaust Flues
core_rationale: Southern brass chimney canyon of Continent 02 where Krono's deep furnace flues vent golden soot-clouds and warm thermal currents across the border cliffs.
local_conflict: Soot-gremlins and cinder-constructs nest inside the southern flue dampers, threatening to choke the steppe wind-turbines.

portal_edges.lock_reason: Scalding golden exhaust plumes vent through the Cinder Chimney Damper; the Bellows Guild requires the Master Damper Crank from Ash-Valve Vault before opening the northern flue.

mystery_hook.in_world_rumor: Chimney-sweeps from Pinion Terminus claim that golden gear-coins rain from the southern flues whenever Krono's deep furnace sighs.
mystery_hook.visual_silhouette: A row of fluted brass smokestacks rising out of a golden mist canyon along the southern steppe rim.
mystery_hook.unanswered_question: Which forgotten furnace-keeper locked the southern damper gates during the Clockspring War?

causal_continuity.evidence: Directly inherits god-krono-brass-titan and scar-brass-faultline on Continent 02 The Clockwork Steppe.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Fluted brass smokestacks venting golden mist and warm thermal updrafts along the southern canyon rim.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: Uses 12.5m riveted brass flue catwalks, 0.60m damper-wheel benches, and 0.15m grate-steps for 1.05m characters.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: 2x2 connected matrix ([0, 1] Flue Causeway, [1, 1] Bellows Hearth, [1, 1] floor -1 Ash-Valve Vault, [1, 0] Cinder Chimney) with construct and spirit families.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Preserves hunting-area-cinder-chimney at [1, 0] as an intentional Mystery frontier gated by a fog_of_lore damper lock.
